about: Expected levelling results for the two fictional fixtures, fixed before the levelling engine exists. Values come from the compendium pages cited; the vocabulary is in partner-kit/docs/design.md section 7.2. Later cards may not edit this file.

plugin_name.reason: The card names the kit's existing deal-team role plugin, twin-pe-deal-team, in role.plugin_name.

distribution.reason: On Enterprise a plugin can be shared per group, so the deal-team plugin reaches the deal-team group only.

settings_baseline.reason: Highly sensitive work needs the controls page 10 requires for it (org lock via MDM, a sandbox that fails closed, allowlists, redaction hooks), and the industry pack's settings baseline is where we keep them; our choice. A pack with no baseline leaves this undecided.

runtime.reason: A person starts the task in a conversation and reviews the result, so it is a client skill.

identity.reason: A client skill runs as the signed-in user: their own permissions, with connectors each person signs in to. A connector whose page-11 row says otherwise (Intercom acts as the admin who authorized it; Dynamics uses a custom Entra app) is listed in connectors[], where its identity is checked against that row.

autonomy.ceiling.reason: No rule on page 06 caps this task lower, so it may rise to level 3 once evals support it; a person starts it, so not to unattended level 4.
